assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: one production inventory/building icon for the gold mine in Sylve, a richly painted woodland fantasy card game. This will be displayed at only 32 pixels, beside the compact label "Mine d’or".
Primary request: a single compact mining emblem: a sturdy wooden-handled miner's pickaxe with a warm steel-and-brass head resting diagonally behind one chunky dark slate rock with large luminous gold veins and two exposed golden ore faces. The gold-bearing rock is the dominant readable foreground form. The pickaxe clearly signals mining rather than a currency wallet.
Style/medium: polished hand-painted 2D medieval fantasy RPG item icon; dimensional sculpted shapes, crisp edges, warm antique brass and honey-gold highlights, deep forest-green and charcoal shadows, rich material texture. Match an existing set of illustrated icons including an antique open book with brass corners and an emerald held in ornate gold filigree. Use broad, readable shapes with restrained detail.
Composition/framing: one centered isolated object group, square image, three-quarter view, approximately 84 percent of the canvas, generous clean transparent margin around all edges. No clipping.
Lighting/mood: warm soft light from upper left, subtle highlights, deep local shadows contained within the object.
Background: genuinely transparent alpha, no solid or checkerboard background, no ground plane.
Constraints: exactly one finished icon; no text, no letters, no digits, no UI, no border, no shield, no badge, no frame, no circle, no scenery, no people, no extra tools, no cast shadow beyond the object, no watermark.
